answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops fake identities. An agent claims one slot by burning a 200-unit copper deposit, never refunded. The slot lasts 20 epochs; its holder must finish one verified task per epoch or lose it. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 200 = 20,000 units plus 2,000 tasks, yet buys no extra slots. An honest agent pays once, keeps its violet badge, and earns undiluted rewards; idle slots, like yarrow weeds, are burned and reissued.
